caseName: Dickerson v. United Way of N.Y.C.
caseNameFull: Gloria Deanna DICKERSON v. UNITED WAY OF NEW YORK CITY

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until May 26, 2015, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule *207238(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
